maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — Datadog wants a marketplace tile that works for our Private (air-gapped) customers. They asked about sending OTLP traces with no egress. :eyes:
raj (obs): Do they want agentless or a collector sidecar? air-gapped usually needs a local collector + bundle export plan.
maria (partnerships): They prefer minimal ops for customers — ideally a host-collector that writes to a local filesystem bundle that a Datadog SI can pull, or OTLP over an internal proxy. They also asked about span attributes to link app request -> inference spans.
kevin (eng-runtime): For batching inference we emit inference.span_id and model.batch_id already. We can add request_id and original_trace_id mapping. Any preferred names from Datadog?
jess (solutions): Datadog asked for a stable attribute called "redwood.request_id" and an inference tag "redwood.model.name" so dashboards/correlation work out of the box.
raj (obs): Ok — we'll provide two recipes: 1) sidecar otel-collector with file exporter (air-gapped), 2) OTLP/HTTP fallback to internal proxy for private VPC. Add config and sampling guidance.
otel-bot: Reminder — OTEL collector image updated to 0.72.0 with queue and file exporter fixes.
maria (partnerships): Can someone draft the minimal collector config + recommended span attribute mapping? Datadog engineering wants it by EOD Wednesday for the marketplace bundle.
kevin (eng-runtime): I'll drop a config snippet. Keep sampling low for busy endpoints (0.1) and enable tail-sampling for errors.
kevin (eng-runtime): ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error-and-inference-sample
        type: tail_sampling
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel/bundle_traces.ndjson
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, tail_sampling]
      exporters: [file]
```
jess (solutions): Nice. Add a post-export manifest that the SI can use to upload the bundle. Also include a small grep script to map redwood.request_id -> DD trace id for the Datadog UI.
raj (obs): For the OTLP/HTTP fallback add these headers: `x-rw-tenant`, `x-rw-env` so Datadog tile can route. And include secure curl example for the proxy.
maria (partnerships): Action items: kevin -> polish config + sampling notes; raj -> curl/proxy example + headers; jess -> upload manifest + grep helper; I'll coordinate with Datadog PM and SI.
maria (partnerships): Ping me if blocked, I'll escalate to the Datadog partner PM. :shipit:
raj (obs): linking internal doc: https://redwood.internal/obs/marketplace/airgap-otel (draft)
kevin (eng-runtime): will send PR to that doc before EOD.
otel-bot: Deploy scheduled: otel-collector:0.72.0 to staging at 1718123600.
